Certificate revocation list.question: The _____ was List of revoked digital certificates.
Certificate revocation list.fact: In cryptography, a certificate revocation list (CRL) is "a list of digital certificates that have been revoked by the issuing certificate authority (CA) before their scheduled expiration date and should no longer be trusted".

Browsers and other relying parties might use CRLs, or might use alternate certificate revocation technologies (such as OCSP) or CRLSets (a dataset derived from CRLs) to check certificate revocation status.

Certificate revocation list.subject: Computer & IT
Certificate revocation list.question: Note that _____ is falling out of favor due to privacy and performance concerns, resulting in a return to CRLs
Certificate revocation list.fact: Browsers and other relying parties might use CRLs, or might use alternate certificate revocation technologies (such as OCSP) or CRLSets (a dataset derived from CRLs) to check certificate revocation status. Certificate revocation list.subject: Computer & IT
Certificate revocation list.question: As a short-term fix, a patch was issued for the relevant _____ software (most importantly Windows) specifically listing the two certificates in question as "revoked"
Certificate revocation list.fact: In a noteworthy example, a certificate for Microsoft was mistakenly issued to an unknown individual, who had successfully posed as Microsoft to the CA contracted to maintain the ActiveX 'publisher certificate' system (VeriSign). COBOL.fact: It was created as part of a US Department of Defense effort to create a portable programming language for data processing. It was originally seen as a stopgap, but the Defense Department promptly pressured computer manufacturers to provide it, resulting in its widespread adoption.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: It was originally seen as a stopgap, but the _____ promptly pressured computer manufacturers to provide it, resulting in its widespread adoption
COBOL.fact: It was originally seen as a stopgap, but the Defense Department promptly pressured computer manufacturers to provide it, resulting in its widespread adoption.

COBOL.question: It was standardized in _____ and has been revised five times
COBOL.fact: It was standardized in 1968 and has been revised five times.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: The current standard is ISO/IEC _____:2023
COBOL.fact: The current standard is ISO/IEC 1989:2023.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: A _____ survey had found that in any data processing installation, the programming cost US$800,000 on average and that translating programs to run on new hardware would cost US$600,000
COBOL.fact: A 1959 survey had found that in any data processing installation, the programming cost US$800,000 on average and that translating programs to run on new hardware would cost US$600,000. On 8 April 1959, Mary K. Hawes, a computer scientist at Burroughs Corporation, called a meeting of representatives from academia, computer users, and manufacturers at the University of Pennsylvania to organize a formal meeting on common business languages.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: Representatives included _____ (inventor of the English-like data processing language FLOW-MATIC), Jean Sammet, and Saul Gorn
COBOL.fact: Representatives included Grace Hopper (inventor of the English-like data processing language FLOW-MATIC), Jean Sammet, and Saul Gorn.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: At the April meeting, the group asked the _____ of Defense (DoD) to sponsor an effort to create a common business language
COBOL.fact: At the April meeting, the group asked the Department of Defense (DoD) to sponsor an effort to create a common business language.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: The delegation impressed _____, director of the Data System Research Staff at the DoD, who thought that they "thoroughly understood" the DoD's problems
COBOL.fact: The delegation impressed Charles A. Phillips, director of the Data System Research Staff at the DoD, who thought that they "thoroughly understood" the DoD's problems.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: It was attended by 41 people and was chaired by _____
COBOL.fact: Charles Phillips agreed to sponsor the meeting, and tasked the delegation with drafting the agenda. It was attended by 41 people and was chaired by Phillips.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: The Department of _____ was concerned about whether it could run the same data processing programs on different computers
COBOL.fact: The Department of Defense was concerned about whether it could run the same data processing programs on different computers.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: A majority agreed that the language should make maximal use of _____, be capable of change, be machine-independent, and be easy to use, even at the expense of power
COBOL.fact: A majority agreed that the language should make maximal use of English, be capable of change, be machine-independent, and be easy to use, even at the expense of power.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: The short-range committee was given until _____ (three months) to produce specifications for an interim language, which would then be improved upon by the other committees
COBOL.fact: The short-range committee was given until September (three months) to produce specifications for an interim language, which would then be improved upon by the other committees.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: One member, _____, described the three-month deadline as "gross optimism" and doubted that the language really would be a stopgap
COBOL.fact: One member, Betty Holberton, described the three-month deadline as "gross optimism" and doubted that the language really would be a stopgap.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: The steering committee met on 4 June and agreed to name the entire activity the Committee on _____, or CODASYL, and to form an executive committee
COBOL.fact: The steering committee met on 4 June and agreed to name the entire activity the Committee on Data Systems Languages, or CODASYL, and to form an executive committee.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: The computer manufacturers were _____, IBM, Minneapolis-Honeywell (Honeywell Labs), RCA, Sperry Rand, and Sylvania Electric Products
COBOL.fact: The computer manufacturers were Burroughs Corporation, IBM, Minneapolis-Honeywell (Honeywell Labs), RCA, Sperry Rand, and Sylvania Electric Products.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: The government agencies were the U.S. Air Force, the Navy's _____, and the National Bureau of Standards (now the National Institute of Standards and Technology)
COBOL.fact: The government agencies were the U.S. Air Force, the Navy's David Taylor Model Basin, and the National Bureau of Standards (now the National Institute of Standards and Technology).

COBOL.fact: The committee was chaired by Joseph Wegstein of the U.S. National Bureau of Standards.

COBOL.fact: The committee mainly examined the FLOW-MATIC, AIMACO, and COMTRAN programming languages. The FLOW-MATIC language was particularly influential because it had been implemented and because AIMACO was a derivative of it with only minor changes.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: The FLOW-MATIC language was particularly influential because it had been implemented and because _____ was a derivative of it with only minor changes
COBOL.fact: The committee mainly examined the FLOW-MATIC, AIMACO, and COMTRAN programming languages. The FLOW-MATIC language was particularly influential because it had been implemented and because AIMACO was a derivative of it with only minor changes.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: FLOW-MATIC's inventor, _____, also served as a technical adviser to the committee
COBOL.fact: FLOW-MATIC's inventor, Grace Hopper, also served as a technical adviser to the committee. Hopper is sometimes called "the mother of COBOL" or "the grandmother of COBOL", although Jean Sammet, a lead designer of COBOL, said Hopper "was not the mother, creator, or developer of Cobol." IBM's COMTRAN language, invented by Bob Bemer, was regarded as a competitor to FLOW-MATIC by a short-range committee made up of colleagues of Grace Hopper.

COBOL.fact: They described new versions in 1968, 1969, 1970, and 1973, including changes such as new inter-program communication, debugging, and file merging facilities, as well as improved string handling and library inclusion features.

COBOL.fact: The DoD operated 225 computers, had 175 more on order, and had spent over $200 million on implementing programs to run on them.

COBOL.fact: In 1980, Grace Hopper commented that "COBOL 60 is 95% FLOW-MATIC" and that COMTRAN had had an "extremely small" influence.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT

COBOL.fact: In 1980, Grace Hopper commented that "COBOL 60 is 95% FLOW-MATIC" and that COMTRAN had had an "extremely small" influence. Furthermore, she said that she would claim that work was influenced by both FLOW-MATIC and COMTRAN only to "keep other people happy [so they] wouldn't try to knock us out.".

Comma-separated values.fact: The IBM Fortran (level H extended) compiler under OS/360 supported list-directed ("free-form") input/output, with commas between values, in 1972. List-directed input/output was defined in FORTRAN 77, approved in 1978.

Command (computing).subject: Computer & IT
Command (computing).question: The _____ was External instruction to a computer program.
Command (computing).fact: In computing, a command is a high-level instruction received via an external interface that directs the behavior of a computer program. Commonly, commands are sent to a program via a command-line interface, a script, a network protocol, or as an event triggered in a graphical user interface.

Command (computing).subject: Computer & IT
Command (computing).question: For example, printing a message in Bash is via the command printf, while in _____ it is via the function print()
Command (computing).fact: For example, printing a message in Bash is via the command printf, while in Python it is via the function print(). For example, conditional logic in Bash and Python is called an expression and statements in Java.
